ceo.name: Andre G. Mousseau
ceo.title: President and Chief Executive Officer, ivari; President and Chief Executive Officer, Sagicor Financial Company Ltd.
ceo.reports_to: ivari Board of Directors (Chairman Gilbert S. Palter); Sagicor Financial Board (Chair Mahmood Khimji)
ceo.prior: Sagicor Financial: Group CFO 2019-02 to 2023, Group COO 2021-08 to 2023, President & CEO from 2023-04-01; before Sagicor 20+ years as private equity investor/executive (Alignvest Private Capital, Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, EdgeStone Capital Partners)
ceo.tenure_source: press release (Group CFO effective 2019-02-01; Group COO effective 2021-08-01; CEO effective 2023-04-01); ivari CEO date 2024-07-31 per Sagicor AIF 2025 (round-1 source), not re-confirmed by a press release this round; Sagicor investor update ('over 20 years' - start year not stated)
ceo.note: Signed ivari FY2025 statements as President & CEO; sits on the ivari board. Sagicor AR 2025 p.11: 'He also currently acts as the Chief Executive Officer of ivari, SFC's wholly-owned Canadian subsidiary, and Sagicor USA.' Succeeded Todd Lawrence (ivari CEO 2018-10 to 2024). Pay is in Sagicor's 2026 management information circular (SEDAR+), not retrievable; no figure entered.

cio.title: Not identified - ivari and Sagicor Financial name no Chief Investment Officer or head of investments
cio.note: ivari's FY2025 statements describe an Asset-Liability Management working group that 'oversees market-risk strategy, policy compliance, investment and hedging performance' under the management Risk and Capital Committee and the Board Investment and Risk Committee, but name no investment officer. Sagicor's 14-person executive team (AR 2025 p.11) contains no CIO; the only Sagicor CIO found (Tracy-Ann Spence) is at Sagicor Group Jamaica, a separate listed subsidiary with no ivari remit. ivari job postings evidence an in-house Investments department: 'AVP, Investments' (posted 2025-08-30; an 'AVP, Asset Liability Management' role reports to it) and 'Vice President ALM and Investment Strategy' (posted 2026-04-24) - names of incumbents not public.
